"Seetahul, Yashvin" <Yashvin.Seetahul@uibk.ac.at>:
Dear Avicenna sales team, We would like to connect the following study to our license at the University of Innsbruck (psychology department). Study-ID: 4096 How much licenses should be allocated: 400 How long is each individual participant part of the study: up to 14 days How long does data collection last for the whole study: Starting from 28.10.2024 until 10.11.2024 Short description of the study: We will conduct a daily diary study over one workweek. To collect data, participants fill in four questionnaires per day in an interval-contingent design to assess job stressors and well-being indicators Furthermore we investigate more precisely when TASW takes place, by establishing an event-contingent diary design, where participants answer questions about their TASW behavior. Thank you in advance, Best regards, Yashvin------

Sara Farnya <sales@avicennaresearch.com>:
Dear Yashvin,I hope all is well with you.Thank you very much for sharing this information with us. Study ID: 4096 has been added to your license and it's all set on our end.If you need anything else, please feel free to contact us.Best,SaraOn Wednesday, October 2, 2024 at 2:45:29 PM,
